description: Editable copy contract for the PMG Used Car Sales theme. Every brand-voice string a prospect reads is a field here; resolveText(brand, key) renders brand.text[key] (operator/LLM override) → default (token-interpolated) → ''. The AI brand generator reads this to know what copy to write. Tokens: {brandName} {namePossessive} {city} {county} {cityish} {streetLine} {postcode} {year} {tagline}. Do NOT write {tokens} into brand.text — the runtime interpolates after.

fields.default: This is information you give us by filling in forms or enquiry widgets on this website, or by corresponding with us by phone, WhatsApp, email or in person at our {city} showroom. It includes details you provide when you make an enquiry, request a vehicle valuation, reserve a car, apply for finance, ask us to source a vehicle, or report a problem with the site. This may include your name, address, email address and phone number, driving-licence and proof-of-address details for identity checks, part-exchange vehicle details, and — where you apply for finance — the information required by our lending partners.
fields.aiHint: Details the information the visitor provides; {city} is the showroom town.

fields.label: Sub-section: collected automatically
fields.default: Information we collect about you automatically
fields.aiHint: Subheading for automatically collected data.

fields.label: Collected automatically — intro
fields.default: With regard to each of your visits to this site we may automatically collect:
fields.aiHint: Lead-in before the automatically-collected data list.

fields.label: Auto — technical info bullet
fields.default: technical information, including the IP address used to connect your device to the internet, browser type and version, time-zone setting, operating system and platform;
fields.aiHint: Bullet listing technical data collected automatically.

fields.label: Auto — visit info bullet
fields.default: information about your visit, including the pages and vehicles you viewed or searched for, page response times, how you reached and left the site, and how you interacted with it.
fields.aiHint: Bullet listing behavioural/visit data collected automatically.

fields.label: Sub-section: from other sources
fields.default: Information we receive from other sources
fields.aiHint: Subheading for data received from third parties.

fields.label: From other sources — body
fields.default: We work with third parties — including finance brokers and lenders, credit-reference and fraud-prevention agencies, our vehicle-history providers, and analytics providers — and may receive information about you from them. Where we do, we will use it only for the purposes set out in this policy.
fields.aiHint: Explains data received from partners and how it is used.

fields.label: Section: cookies
fields.aiHint: Heading for the cookies section.

fields.label: Cookies — body (before link)
fields.default: Our website uses cookies to distinguish you from other users, to help the site work, and to let us improve it. For detailed information on the cookies we use and how to manage them, please see our
fields.aiHint: Cookie summary that precedes the inline Cookie Policy link.

fields.label: Cookie Policy link text
fields.aiHint: Link text pointing to the cookie policy page.

fields.label: Section: how we use your information
fields.aiHint: Heading for how data is used.

fields.label: How we use — intro
fields.default: We use the information we hold about you to:
fields.aiHint: Lead-in before the list of uses.

fields.label: Use — respond bullet
fields.default: respond to your enquiries, arrange viewings and test drives, reserve vehicles, and carry out our obligations under any contract between you and us;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: responding to enquiries and fulfilling contracts.

fields.label: Use — finance bullet
fields.default: process finance applications and identity/affordability checks with your consent, through our regulated lending partners;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: processing finance applications.

fields.label: Use — part-exchange bullet
fields.default: value your part-exchange and source a vehicle to your specification when you ask us to;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: valuing part-exchange and sourcing vehicles.

fields.label: Use — delivery bullet
fields.default: arrange delivery, warranty, valeting and after-sales support in connection with your purchase;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: delivery, warranty and after-sales.

fields.label: Use — notify bullet
fields.default: notify you about changes to our service, and keep our site safe and secure;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: service notifications and security.

fields.label: Use — marketing bullet
fields.default: where you have consented, send you information about vehicles or offers that may interest you — you can withdraw that consent at any time (see “Your rights” below).
fields.aiHint: Bullet: consented marketing with withdrawal note.

fields.label: Section: lawful bases
fields.aiHint: Heading for lawful bases of processing.

fields.label: Lawful bases — body
fields.default: We only process your personal data where we have a lawful basis to do so: to perform a contract with you (or take steps at your request before entering one); to comply with a legal obligation; where you have given consent (for example, marketing); or where it is in our legitimate interests to do so and those interests are not overridden by your rights.
fields.aiHint: Explains the legal bases relied on for processing.

fields.label: Section: sharing
fields.aiHint: Heading for who data is shared with.

fields.label: Sharing — intro
fields.default: We may share your personal data with:
fields.aiHint: Lead-in before the sharing list.

fields.label: Share — finance bullet
fields.default: finance brokers and lenders, where you ask us to arrange finance, and credit-reference and fraud-prevention agencies for the associated checks;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: sharing with finance and credit agencies.

fields.label: Share — suppliers bullet
fields.default: suppliers and sub-contractors who help us deliver our service — for example vehicle transport/delivery, warranty administrators, payment processors and IT providers;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: sharing with service suppliers and sub-contractors.

fields.label: Share — analytics bullet
fields.default: analytics providers who help us improve the site;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: sharing with analytics providers.

fields.label: Share — law bullet
fields.default: law-enforcement, regulators or other authorities where we are under a legal duty to disclose or share your data.
fields.aiHint: Bullet: sharing with authorities under legal duty.

fields.label: Sharing — no-sell note
fields.default: We will not sell your personal data, and we will not share it with third parties for their own marketing purposes without your consent.
fields.aiHint: Reassurance that data is not sold or shared for others' marketing.

fields.label: Section: where we store data
fields.aiHint: Heading for data storage and transfers.

fields.label: Where we store data — body
fields.default: All information you provide is stored on secure servers. Where a supplier processes data outside the UK or European Economic Area, we take steps to ensure it is protected to a standard equivalent to UK data protection law. Unfortunately the transmission of information over the internet is never completely secure; while we do our best to protect your data, any transmission is at your own risk.
fields.aiHint: Explains secure storage, international transfers and transmission risk.

fields.label: Section: retention
fields.default: How long we keep your data
fields.aiHint: Heading for data retention periods.

fields.label: Retention — body
fields.default: We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. Where you have purchased a vehicle, obtained finance or a warranty through us, we typically retain the associated records for up to 7 years to meet our legal and financial obligations. Enquiry data where no purchase is made is held for a shorter period and then securely deleted. We review the data we hold regularly.
fields.aiHint: Explains how long different categories of data are kept.

fields.label: Section: your rights
fields.aiHint: Heading for the visitor's data-protection rights.

fields.label: Your rights — intro
fields.default: Under UK data protection law you have the right to:
fields.aiHint: Lead-in before the list of rights.

fields.label: Right — access bullet
fields.default: ask for a copy of the personal data we hold about you;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: right of access.

fields.label: Right — rectification bullet
fields.default: ask us to correct data that is inaccurate or incomplete;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: right to correct inaccurate data.

fields.label: Right — erasure bullet
fields.default: ask us to erase your data, or restrict how we use it, in certain circumstances;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: right to erasure/restriction.

fields.label: Right — object bullet
fields.default: object to processing that we carry out on the basis of legitimate interests;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: right to object to legitimate-interests processing.

fields.label: Right — withdraw consent bullet
fields.default: withdraw consent for marketing at any time;
fields.aiHint: Bullet: right to withdraw marketing consent.

fields.label: Right — portability bullet
fields.default: ask us to provide your data in a structured, machine-readable form, or transfer it to another organisation, where technically feasible.
fields.aiHint: Bullet: right to data portability.

fields.label: Rights — ICO sentence (before link)
fields.default: To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) at
fields.aiHint: Sentence before the inline ico.org.uk link.

fields.label: Rights — ICO sentence (after link)
fields.default: , though we would appreciate the chance to resolve your concern first.
fields.aiHint: Sentence that follows the ico.org.uk link.

fields.label: Section: links to other sites
fields.aiHint: Heading for third-party links.

fields.label: Links to other sites — body
fields.default: Our site may contain links to third-party websites (for example finance partners or social media). Those sites have their own privacy policies and we do not accept responsibility for them. Please check their policies before submitting any personal data.
fields.aiHint: Disclaimer about third-party linked sites.

fields.label: Section: changes
fields.aiHint: Heading for policy updates.

fields.label: Changes — body
fields.default: Any changes we make to this policy will be posted on this page. Please check back occasionally to stay informed of any updates.
fields.aiHint: Note that policy changes are posted on the page.

fields.label: Callout heading
fields.aiHint: Heading of the contact callout box.

fields.label: Callout body (before controller)
fields.default: Questions, requests or complaints about this policy or how we handle your data are welcome and should be addressed to
fields.aiHint: Contact sentence; the controller name/address is appended after this.

fields.label: Callout — email connector
fields.aiHint: Connector before the inline email address (only shown when an email exists).

fields.label: Call button label
fields.aiHint: Prefix before the phone number on the call button.

fields.aiHint: Label on the email button.
